MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB SanDisk card with an adapter fits my repeated purchases of memory cards and the card reader and storage cases I use with them.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables would make my existing card reader and other USB accessories easier to connect and reach.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my TV: streaming, even though my 720p screen would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Blink bundle introduce smart-speaker, video-calling, and home-security uses that I have not shown a need for; my photography accessories do not imply an interest in security cameras.",
    "Buying cables does not mean any cable is useful to me: six one-foot Ethernet leads do not fit a connection need I currently have.",
    "The larger Fire tablet duplicates a need my Fire 7 already covers, while the earbuds address a listening need I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although I chose it for a particular use.",
    "My purchases of cameras, cables, and accessories seem to have been treated as broad interest in electronics, without enough attention to what each device would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy memory cards and accessories for storing, reading, and organizing them, so practical additions to that setup are especially relevant.",
    "The connector, length, capacity, and intended device matter to me more than whether an item broadly resembles something I bought before.",
    "Owning a device can create a need for compatible accessories without creating a need to replace it; my Fire 7 case and mount suggest continued use of that tablet."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in practical accessories but stretched it into device purchases without a clear current purpose."
}
